title: Delhi High Court allows Sonam Wangchuk to be shifted to Medanta Hospital
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday allowed activist Sonam Wangchuk, who is on hunger strike in solidarity with the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) student protest, to be shifted to a hospital of his choice. [Gitanjali Angmo v. Union of India].A Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia said,"What we propose to do is get him shifted to the hospital of his choice, that is Medanta.
